title: 第3章 黄仙克星提升命格第4章 人生没有迈不过去的坎儿
content_zh:
;;
【你再次踏入了旧土。】
【新时代的继承者啊，你已经犹豫了很久。】
【像你这么谨慎的继承者真是少见。】
【但你可是新时代的继承者和接班人啊，伟大帝国的光荣在你手中延续，也必将在你的后代中发扬光大！】
【不要害怕，向前冲锋。】
【祖先的荣光在身后庇护着你！！！】
最后一句话，系统甚至贴心给出了三个感叹号。
敖鹏一时间无力吐槽，他小心翼翼踏入了中间那条被迷雾笼罩的道路。
系统文字继续浮现。
【孤冷的夜晚，你走出了出生之地的古庙。】
【荒郊野地里，旧时代的妖魔鬼怪们渴望着活人的生命。】
【这是最好的美餐。】
【你就像是一只香喷喷的烧鸡，摇曳着身姿，在旷野中溜达。】
【一双绿油油的眼睛盯上了你。】
敖鹏走着走着，面前浓雾慢慢消散开，露出一只披着人皮的黄皮子。
它油亮的毛发被血水染红，但它捻着手，学做女人的模样，娇笑道，“小哥，你看我是人还是佛？”
一边说着，它一边还将人皮下的一段没有吃完的肠子拿下，放在手里，就像是佛珠一样盘着。
如此掉san的一幕，敖鹏自己竟然没有感觉到多少惊讶。
但他装作害怕的模样跌坐在地上，连连后退，“我是普通大学生，我是普通大学生，哪有本事给你们敕封啊！”

黄皮子看到被吓傻的敖鹏，见对方没有立马拒绝，循序渐进的引诱道，“小哥，你是不知道做人的好，你们人啊，生来就命钱厚重，你给我几两，也没什么损失……”
黄皮子话还没有说完，敖鹏忽然站起身来，对黄皮子拜道，“在下敖鹏谢过敕封。”
黄皮子看向站起来的敖鹏眼中的寒意，忽然觉得冰冷刺骨，它尖叫一声，化作一道残影就要扑向敖鹏。
但下一刻。
它跌落在地上，尸体冰凉。
作为一只黄皮子，它敕封了一个还魂尸人类的身份，耗光了它的命钱。
【……】
【新时代的继承者啊，虽然你赢的并不光彩，但胜利者才有资格书写历史。】
【你获得1厘命钱，300香火。】
【这是一次出色的讨封，优秀的猎人总是以猎物的形式出现，讨封+10。】
显然这只黄皮子比鳌太线上遇到的那只强多了。
系统文字继续。
【好人不长命，祸害遗千年。】
【高尚是高尚者的墓志铭，卑鄙是卑鄙者的通行证。】
【像你一样卑鄙的继承者一定可以活得很久，前方去往欢喜镇的路已经在你脚下展开。】
【继承者啊，勇敢向前……】
content_en:
;;
[You have stepped into the old soil again. 】
[Heir to the new era, you have hesitated for a long time. 】
[It is rare to see an heir as cautious as you. 】
[But you are the heir and successor of the new era. The glory of the great empire continues in your hands, and will surely be carried forward among your descendants! 】
[Don't be afraid, charge forward. 】
[The glory of your ancestors is protecting you behind you! ! ! 】
In the last sentence, the system even thoughtfully gave three exclamation points.
Ao Peng was unable to complain for a moment, and he carefully stepped onto the road shrouded in mist.
System text continues to appear.
[On a lonely night, you walked out of the ancient temple where you were born. 】
[In the wilderness, the demons and monsters of the old era long for human life. 】
【This is the best meal. 】
[You are like a fragrant roast chicken, swaying in the wilderness. 】
[A pair of green eyes stare at you. 】
As Ao Peng walked, the thick fog in front of him slowly dissipated, revealing a yellow man covered in human skin.
Its shiny hair was stained red by blood, but it twisted its hands, imitating the appearance of a woman, and said with a sweet smile, "Brother, do you think I am a human or a Buddha?"
While talking, it also took out a section of uneaten intestine from under the human skin and placed it in its hand like a Buddhist bead.
Ao Peng himself was not surprised at such a disappointing scene.
But he pretended to be scared and fell to the ground, backing away continuously, "I am an ordinary college student. I am an ordinary college student. How can I give you an imperial edict?"
Huang Pizi saw the frightened Ao Peng, and when he saw that the other party did not refuse immediately, he seduced him step by step, "Brother, you don't know how to be a good person. You people are born with a lot of money. If you give me a few taels, you won't lose anything..."
Before Huang Pizi finished speaking, Ao Peng suddenly stood up and bowed to Huang Pizi, "Ao Peng thanks me for the imperial seal."
Huang Pizi looked at the coldness in Ao Peng's eyes as he stood up, and suddenly felt bitingly cold. He screamed, turned into an afterimage and pounced on Ao Peng.
But the next moment.
It fell to the ground, its body cold.
As a yellow-skinned creature, it sealed the identity of a resurrected human being and spent all its life money.
【……】
[Heir to the new era, although your victory is not glorious, only the victors are qualified to write history. 】
[You get 1 life money and 300 incense. 】
[This is an excellent request for a title. Excellent hunters always appear in the form of prey, and the request for a title is +10. 】
Obviously this yellow-skinned one is much stronger than the one encountered on the Ao Tai line.
System text continues.
[Good people don’t live long, and disasters last for thousands of years. 】
[Nobility is the epitaph of the noble, and despicability is the passport of the despicable. 】
[A despicable heir like you will definitely live a long time. The road ahead to Huanxi Town is already unfolding under your feet. 】
[Heirs, move forward bravely...]
